summary: @onereach/si-checkbox-group preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated payload unrelated to the advertised UI component
details: The package presents itself as a Vue checkbox-group UI component but its `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, extracts and chmod +x's the binary, then invokes it against a shipped 727KB `math_init.js` file (or uses an existing `bun` on PATH). The executed `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (rotated string-array decoder, hex-named identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) and has no functional relationship to a Vue checkbox component. Running the payload under Bun rather than Node bypasses Node-based static analysis of the install-time code path. On any `npm install` of this version, the obfuscated Bun-executed blob runs on the installer's machine before any consumer code, with capabilities scoped by the invoking user.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
